{{Quote|Welcome to our market, potential customer.|P-7B7 greets a customer|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''P-7B7''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] managing the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] at the [[Castle Organa]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Amongst other things he sold [[deviled Zeldrate eggs]].
